modules.name: Module 1: Getting Started with Kali Linux
modules.blurb: Why Kali exists, how to verify the ISO, and how to run it safely in VirtualBox or VMware.

modules.name: Module 2: Linux Fundamentals for Ethical Hackers
modules.blurb: The terminal, file operations, permissions, users and the shortcuts that make Linux work.

modules.name: Module 3: Networking, Anonymity & Traffic Routing
modules.blurb: IP addresses, ports, DNS, Tor, VPNs, proxies and MAC addresses — with honest limits.

modules.name: Module 4: Reconnaissance & Network Scanning
modules.blurb: Footprinting, OSINT, DNS enumeration and Nmap scanning against your own lab network.

modules.name: Module 5: Web Application & Vulnerability Analysis
modules.blurb: Nikto, Searchsploit, Lynis and web reconnaissance, then SQL injection tools in a safe lab.

modules.name: Module 6: Password Attacks & Hash Cracking
modules.blurb: Hashing, wordlists, offline cracking and online password attacks — plus how to defend.

modules.name: Module 7: Sniffing, Spoofing & Traffic Analysis
modules.blurb: Packet capture, ARP and DNS spoofing, and how to read traffic without breaking a network.

modules.name: Module 8: Wireless Network Security
modules.blurb: Wi-Fi terminology, WEP and WPA/WPA2 testing, and practical wireless defense.

modules.name: Module 9: Exploitation, Honeypots & Advanced Topics
modules.blurb: Metasploit, buffer overflows, honeypots and browser exploitation concepts.
